name: ridgeline-chart
title: Ridgeline chart
description: A React ridgeline chart: overlapping density ridges per group, computed with a Gaussian kernel and Silverman's bandwidth, with median ticks. Accessible.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Ridgeline chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/ridgeline

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { RidgelineChart, RidgelineTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/ridgeline-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
